#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);keep=int(sys.argv[2])
dry=False
removed=[]
for tenant in sorted(root.iterdir()):
    if not tenant.is_dir():continue
    backups=sorted(p for p in tenant.iterdir() if p.is_file() and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{8}\.bak',p.name))
    removed.extend(backups[:-keep])
for p in sorted(removed,key=lambda p:str(p.relative_to(root))):
    p.unlink()
PY
